title: The Wing
dek: The Wing: Heavy Reading's options section. What traders pay for spike insurance versus crash insurance, off ICE end-of-day settlements, and lesson one: expensive insurance is not a forecast.

claims.text: At the October 23, 2026 ICE Brent settlements (front expiry October 28, 2026), RR25 printed +9.17 points and the 20 percent out-of-the-money call implied volatility 90.37 percent, a tail premium of +43.62 points over at-the-money. Series n = 7 prints from October 15, 2026.
